audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Skill x6, Yone] and the mirror flipped exactly rows 1, 2 and 5 to Skill as one atomic group; whys[1], whys[2] and whys[5] already say skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item phase claimed Blade of the Ruined King as your spike, but both champions build the same crit path and the row is a skill row.
audit.why: whys[5] and spikes[2] both say the item timings mirror; the real edge is execution around Wind Wall and the first Q3.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why rewritten to name the actual deciding factor; phases[2].why re-keyed to the level-3 Q3 race.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither ultimate had a cooldown attached, so 'trade around Last Breath' had no number, and Wind Wall's duration and cooldown were never stated.
audit.why: Last Breath is 70/50/30s against Fate Sealed's 120/100/80s — he can spend his far more often. Wind Wall is 25/23/21/19/17s and stands 4 seconds. Sweeping Blade is 0.5s at rank 1 and carries no knockup; the airborne comes from his two-stack Steel Tempest.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with those numbers.
